predecessor.outcome: coverage passed but frozen power gate failed 0/2

validation_stage.target: control false certification of ANY unsuccessful observed refit
validation_stage.per_component_method: one-sided cluster-jackknife ratio-mean t-test with df=B_g-1
validation_stage.per_refit_iut: all group x ordered contrast lower limits exceed gain_tolerance
validation_stage.calibration_requirement: component nominal size under declared block sampling; normal/t3 scenarios plus prospective stress qualification
validation_stage.correction_axis: R observed refits only; not R times groups times contrasts
validation_stage.argument: For any truly unsuccessful refit, at least one component null holds, so the IUT false certification probability is <=alpha_validation/R; union across R refits yields <=alpha_validation.

process_stage.success_count: K = number of refits certified by all component IUT tests
process_stage.confidence_bound: exact one-sided Clopper-Pearson lower bound on p_success using K of R, alpha=0.025
process_stage.argument: On no-false-certification event K<=S_true; CP bound monotone in success count and S_true follows Binomial(R,p_success).

prospective_qualification.coverage_scenarios: reuse six named p=0.50/0.80/0.95 normal/t3 v1 scenarios exactly
prospective_qualification.power_scenarios: reuse p=1 R8/B8 and R20/B8 worlds with 8-oracle-SE shift exactly
